family_comparisons.existing_scope: Pilot 4 in the generative-mechanism falsification family: implements the Cardan table-and-grille device (M5a independent-column, M5b row-coupled) built from the pinned ZL3b corpus, measures composite distance against real manuscript statistics across 28 configurations plus multi-seed stability, and narrows the residual gap to two local metrics (conditional bigram entropy, word-final predictability), extending outcome-m4-template-doodler-pilot.
family_comparisons.reason: The submission does not implement, test, or extend the Cardan grille mechanism at all; it adds two real-text genre controls to an entry-metric suite from an earlier pilot. The 'extends: outcome-m5-grille-pilot' declaration is lineage framing, not substantive overlap with the grille's delivered mechanism/result.

family_comparisons.existing_scope: A distinct generative-mechanism falsification pilot implementing Stolfi's published 2000 word grammar (core/mantle/crust unimodal-hill slot structure) as a template generator embedded in an entry/topic-carryover engine, and measuring two real-language positive controls (Culpeper's Complete Herbal 1653, Alice in Wonderland) with the identical metric suite against the pinned ZL3b corpus across 12 grid variants, showing (a) real language differs from the manuscript on conditional entropy, final-char entropy and entry-private vocabulary share, reframing prior 'unmatched by content-free generators' results away from a linguistic-content reading, and (b) the published grammar covers 86% of corpus word types with zero fitting and jointly reproduces vocabulary size, ttr, word length and page-sharing, leaving a residual mechanical-repetition signature (H2|1, final-char entropy, Zipf slope, entry-unique overshoot).
family_comparisons.reason: That family already credits the Culpeper/Alice real-language controls and the Stolfi template-generator mechanism. This submission adds no generator and reuses Culpeper/Alice bytes only as re-included baseline rows; its new delivered content is the two additional genre controls (dictionary, kids' encyclopedia) and the resulting corrective interpretive finding, not previously credited there.

family_comparisons.existing_scope: A distinct generative-mechanism falsification pilot testing a content-free per-page entry/topic-carryover generator (M3) against the pinned ZL3b corpus's newly measured page-level structural fingerprint (adjacent vs distant page vocabulary Jaccard, page-unique vocabulary share) across 24 grid variants, showing these page-level metrics are reproducible content-free while character-level residue (H2|1, Zipf slope, word length) persists.
family_comparisons.reason: That family credits a content-free generative M3 mechanism reproducing page-level metrics; this submission adds no generator, instead adding two new real-language genre controls to interpret entry-private vocabulary share using the pre-existing metric definitions, a different informative direction.
